title: FOMO pipeline parameters
description: Annotates candidate lncRNAs on a target assembly by transferring annotation from source species

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to the samplesheet CSV describing source and target species.
input.help_text: Each row needs species, role (source|target), fasta and gff3 columns. See assets/schema_input.json for the per-row schema.

outdir.description: Directory where the pipeline results are published.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to publish files into the output directory.

pipeline_options.title: Pipeline options
pipeline_options.description: Parameters controlling which feature tracks are transferred, decoy generation and the MultiQC report.

relocate_seed.description: Random seed for deterministic decoy relocation.
relocate_seed.help_text: Forwarded to relocate_loci.py --seed so decoy placement is reproducible across runs. Only takes effect with --include_decoy.

decoy_cap.description: Maximum number of decoy models to generate per source feature type.
decoy_cap.help_text: Random sample of N models taken before relocation. Set to 0 to disable the cap (use all eligible models). Only takes effect with --include_decoy.

include_mrna.description: Also transfer the source mRNA track (positive control).
include_mrna.help_text: Off by default: FOMO's deliverable is lncRNA. The mRNA track is a positive control — mRNA projects well from closely related sources, so its gffcompare Sn/Pr bound what the lncRNA track can reach. Turning it on roughly doubles the number of filtering, alignment and benchmarking tasks and adds mRNA rows to every report table.

include_decoy.description: Also build and project the relocated decoy track (false-positive baseline).
include_decoy.help_text: Off by default. Decoys are source loci randomly relocated into that source's own intergenic intervals (see --relocate_seed / --decoy_cap), so any decoy model that projects onto the target is a false positive — the null baseline for the accuracy scatter. Intergenic space is the complement of the ENTIRE source annotation (coding genes included), independently of --include_mrna. One decoy track is built per enabled feature type, so with --include_mrna this doubles again.

include_single_exon.description: Keep single-exon projected models in the BAM-to-GFF3 conversion.
include_single_exon.help_text: Off by default: single-exon projections (alignments with no splice gap) are discarded by bam_to_gff.sh, since source transcripts are spliced and a single-exon projection is usually a collapsed or spurious mapping. Turn on to retain them.

top_consensus_n.description: Number of top sources (by lncRNA transcript F1) pooled into the consensus annotation.
top_consensus_n.help_text: Sources are ranked by lncRNA transcript-level F1 from their gffcompare-vs-reference stats; the top N feed a gffcompare-combine consensus of both their lncRNA and mRNA projections (emitted as the 'top3' / from_top3 models). If fewer than N sources exist, all are combined.

td2_psauron_min.description: PSAURON score at/above which a complete TD2 ORF marks a lncRNA as coding (and drops it).
td2_psauron_min.help_text: Real lncRNA (input and per-source projected) are run through TD2 (TransDecoder2); a transcript with a complete ORF whose psauron_score >= this cutoff is treated as coding-potential and removed. mRNA and decoy tracks are never filtered.

multiqc_main_config.description: MultiQC layout config (title, report comment, section ordering, fn-clean exts).

multiqc_sections_config.description: MultiQC content config (custom_data blocks and sp search patterns).
